_doc: Amane's lines (docs/CAST.md, GDD 4.3). {player} = the protagonist's name, {rival} = the last person Amane saw you get close to. Narration has speaker "".
first_meeting: A first-year in an oversized black hoodie is standing in your way. Rain drips off his bangs. There is a little gold bell on his collar.
His face crumples. Somewhere above the clouds, it starts to rain harder.
N-no. It's fine. I'm Nekomori Amane, class 1-A. I'm not crying. It's just raining.

0: Senpai! I made too much rice this morning. It's not for you. ...It's for you.
Good morning, Senpai. I wasn't waiting. I just happened to be here. For forty minutes.
Senpai, your tie is crooked. Can I-- no. Sorry. Never mind.
I found a four-leaf clover. I'm keeping it in my notebook. Next to your timetable. I mean-- next to MY timetable.
1: Senpai... are you busy? It's okay. I can wait. I'm good at waiting.
You walked right past me. It's fine. I'm used to it.
2: Did I do something wrong, Senpai? *sniff*
I-I'm not crying. Something got in my eye. Both eyes.
3: Senpai hates me now, doesn't he... *hic*
Everyone's staring. Please don't look at me. No-- look at me. No--
4: I waited nine summers and you don't even remember my naaaame!
5: *The rain is so loud you can barely hear him.* SENPAIIII...!

romance: Senpai! You're here! ...I mean. Hello. Normally.
I saved you a seat on the roof. And the seat next to it, so nobody else sits there.
ignore: ...Senpai. I'll stand over here. Far away. Like you wanted.
I won't bother you. I'm just... going the same way. Every way.
boundary: I joined the library committee today, Senpai. Like you said. Nobody talked to me. But I joined.
I ate lunch with someone from my class. We didn't talk. But it counts, right?

dusk: It's almost Omagatoki, Senpai. Please don't count the steps on the way home.
The town chime is playing. Go home before the song ends, Senpai. Promise me.

kind: *His ears pop out from under his hair.* S-Senpai is being nice to me...
Thank you. I'll remember this. I remember everything.
flirt: W-what? Senpai, you can't just-- *steam rises from his head*
*He hides his whole face in his sleeves.* Say that again. No, don't. Yes, do.
boundary: ...Okay. My own friends. I can try that. I think. For Senpai.
That hurt a little. But you said it kindly, so I'll keep it.
reject_soft: O-okay... *sniff* I'll go stand somewhere else.
reject_cry: You said that last time too. You don't remember last time.
reject_wail: WAAAAH! SENPAI, YOU PROMISED! YOU PROMISED NINE YEARS AGO!

choices.boundary_locked: "You need friends..." (wait until he calms down)

clingy: Did you eat? I can bring something.
Which way are you walking home tomorrow? Just asking.
I'll be at the school gate at 7:40. Not because of you.
sad: You read it and didn't answer.
It's okay. I'm used to waiting.
It's raining here. It's raining everywhere, actually. Sorry.
happy: I'm going to sleep now. With my phone. In case.
jealous: I saw you laughing with {rival}. I'm not upset. I'm just asking.
{rival} has a nice laugh. I counted.

doorstep: You slide the shop door open. Amane is sitting on the step outside, soaked, holding a bento. "You blocked me," he says, "so I came to say good morning in person."
